association: Co-amplified with ERBB2 on 17q12 and binds HER2, protecting it from degradation (PMID 31013812). Over-expressed vs normal breast tissue in 88.5% of ERBB2-amplified TCGA tumors.
drug_footnote: These drugs inhibit the 26S proteasome, of which PSMD3 is a subunit (19S cap); they do not bind PSMD3 itself. Approved for myeloma and lymphoma, not breast cancer. HER2+ breast cancer evidence is from cell lines only (PMID 29069787).
trial_note: No trial in the trial database requires or targets PSMD3, and no proteasome-inhibitor trial was found in the Keenable searches.
source: keenable search, papers checked against PubMed (2026-11-14); see keenable/psmd3_keenable_evidence.csv
